checklist: 0:00 = her face + YOU MADE THIS POSSIBLE. No logo, no fade.
No false starts, no “Can you see my phone”, no “Yes.”
Last line is complete and clean (C1 or C2 sound).
Super: Kerri Colfer / Director of Policy and Research, NIWRC. No Tribal affiliation on screen.
Pacing, captions and color match your Cory and tai thank-you clips.
Capital N in “Native” and capital T in “Tribal” everywhere.
No victim imagery. Hopeful, never somber.

decisions.b: The real lines run about 10 s, so the clip lands near 14 s with the end card, not the 22–25 s in the Monday brief. Fine for a donor thank-you unless Nick wants it longer.

client_note: Why this matters: NIWRC sends these thank-you clips to donors after DVAM. Three of them (Cory, Kerri, tai) go out as a set, so they must look and feel the same.
